message.content:
This editorial illustration features an orange cover for "TEMPO" magazine dated "23-29 NOVEMBER 2015." A stylized, monochromatic portrait of a man dominates the frame. The man has short dark hair, one visible eye peeking through his fingers, a straight nose, and a slight smile. He is dressed in a dark jacket, white shirt, and red tie. 

A large, oversized hand is positioned in front of his face, its palm facing outward and fingers spread. The hand appears to be composed of paper-like layers or panels. One finger is partially transparent, revealing his eye. Below his chin, his own actual hands are visible, smaller in scale. The left hand holds a metal tool resembling a pair of tongs or pliers with curved handles.

The text "JAKSA AGUNG: MURAH BANGET NILAI SAYA" appears at the top in yellow and white. Large white block letters on the right read "PAPA MINTA SAHAM." The bottom right corner contains a barcode, the price "RP 39,500," and the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO." The background is a solid, vibrant orange.
